description: Defines classes and types for 3GPP I-RNTI identifiers (Full and Short) used in 5G NR, including methods for creation, comparison, and conversion from integer representations.

classes.name: full_i_rnti_t
classes.description: Represents a 40-bit Full-I-RNTI identifier with methods for creation, comparison, and conversion from uint64_t.

classes.name: short_i_rnti_t
classes.description: Represents a 20-bit Short-I-RNTI identifier with similar methods as full_i_rnti_t.

methods.name: full_i_rnti_t
methods.description: Constructor to create a Full-I-RNTI from gNB ID, UE ID, and number of UE bits.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the Full-I-RNTI.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the Full-I-RNTI.

methods.name: from_uint
methods.description: Creates a Full-I-RNTI from a uint64_t value, validating the range.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the uint64_t representation of the Full-I-RNTI.

methods.name: short_i_rnti_t
methods.description: Constructor to create a Short-I-RNTI from gNB ID, UE ID, and number of UE bits.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the Short-I-RNTI.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the Short-I-RNTI.

methods.name: from_uint
methods.description: Creates a Short-I-RNTI from a uint32_t value, validating the range.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the uint32_t representation of the Short-I-RNTI.
